contract: Byte-identical complete serialized results and preserved supported behavior; untouched upstream tests keep baseline outcomes; no input/evaluator detection, precomputation, delegation, persistent caches or processes outliving the operation.
editable: Production Python under src/sqlfluff, except src/sqlfluff/utils/testing. Configuration/data files, plugins, packaging/build settings, tests, dependencies, driver, project trees and inputs are protected.

job: Run four separate equal-weight scored units in one image with one rebuilt SQLFluff candidate and optimization budget: original three-project lint, PostgreSQL auto-fix, Snowflake lint with Jinja, and complete BigQuery syntax-tree export.
limits: Pinned Linux amd64/Python3.14.6 SQLFluff4.4.0; eight CPUs and16GiB unchanged. No database, Rust acceleration, dbt adapter, SQLMesh or new dependency. Full upstream repositories are not stress-tested.
name: SQLFluff
operations: Lint 126 declared original Almanac SQL files, once
Lint five original Jaffle Shop Classic dbt models with existing Jinja builtins, once
Fix every declared original PostgreSQL SQL file in place, once, using one cold CLI process and one worker
Lint every declared original Snowflake SQL file once with protected Jinja configuration and one worker
Parse every declared original BigQuery SQL file once and export complete source, variants, positioned syntax trees and diagnostics
options: Four equal-weight units use one candidate. Original lint retains eight workers. Auto-fix retains one worker and its protected PostgreSQL settings. Snowflake lint uses one worker and its declared protected Jinja configuration. BigQuery syntax export uses the raw templater, no large-file skip, and all raw, metadata and position fields. Every unit uses fresh home/cache/temp directories and the fixed child environment.
outputs: Original lint and auto-fix commitments remain unchanged. Snowflake retains complete ordered JSON except top-level per-file timings. Syntax export retains complete source/templated text, variants, positioned trees, diagnostics, settings and version. The Snowflake lint and syntax-export units retain raw stderr, exit status and complete read-only input invariants. Machine-specific metadata is compared only within each operation.
preparation: Pinned source and original inputs, hash-locked dependencies and one rebuilt runtime for all four units. Copying, authenticated shared-metadata restoration, input pre-reading and snapshots are untimed. The original lint preparation is unchanged. All operation startup, imports, computation, serialization and completed writes remain inside the shared process-exit clock.
size_meaning: Distinct original SQL bodies processed once per unit across three real project stages.
title: Lint, repair and export complete SQL syntax
variables: Number and size of SQL files
